protocol: Single repeatedly used PixelSeal57-image developmental fold;90 real scorer training,23 inner calibration;113-real-trained base used for all features (in-sample meta-training limitation). One fit and final evaluation; not full OOF. At most one toggle to avoid nonadditive two-action damage.

control_b.wrong_message_note: Only new message features swapped; base and proposal masks held fixed. Physical target unchanged.

pcmv.wrong_message_note: Only new message features swapped; base and proposal masks held fixed. Physical target unchanged.

oracle_note: Exact<=2 disjoint proposal toggles, GT-only diagnostic; no-op included. Deployment is<=1 toggle. Never used to select feature/proposal parameters.
selection_rule: Gain>0.01 vs best base, paired95% lower bound>0, beats proposal-only control, clean/full twin false-toggle<2% and mean mIoU drop<0.003; fixed before scorer fitting/evaluation.
